name: When should I call a plumber for rusty water?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a plumber for rusty water?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber for rusty water if the problem is persistent, only affects hot water, or if running your cold water faucets for 15-30 minutes doesn't clear it up. If the rusty water is accompanied by low water pressure, a metallic smell, or significant staining, it's also time to call. These signs can indicate serious issues like corroding pipes, a failing water heater, or problems with your main water supply line that require professional diagnosis and repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if rusty water is persistent, only hot, doesn't clear after running faucets, or has low pressure, smell, or staining.
